body: Wild test-time adaptation (WTTA) updates a source model online under small test batches, concurrent distribution shifts, and time-varying class imbalance. Most WTTA methods derive their adaptation signals, including predictive uncertainty, sample reliability, and local feature geometry, from the model being adapted. When the source model is unreliable under shift, these signals can reinforce its own errors, forming a self-referential loop. We introduce MASA (Multimodal-LLM-Anchored Semantic Adaptation), which complements model-internal evidence with structured semantic descriptions from a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). To limit inference cost, MASA queries the MLLM only for a small set of diverse, reliability-ranked anchors. The resulting descriptions capture the object family and nuisance factors such as style, viewpoint, and occlusion. MASA encodes these descriptions, propagates them to neighboring test samples, and stores the resulting visual-semantic information in an online prototype memory. Descriptor-aware retrieval from this memory provides an auxiliary target for lightweight adaptation of normalization-affine parameters. We evaluate MASA on the WTTA ImageNet-C benchmark under limited-batch, mixed-domain, and imbalanced-label-shift settings with ResNet and ViT backbones.
summaryZh: 针对野外测试时适应（WTTA）中模型因自引用导致的错误累积问题，本文提出了MASA框架。该方法利用冻结的多模态大模型（MLLM）提供结构化语义描述作为锚点，辅助在线模型进行适应。通过存储视觉-语义信息至在线原型内存，MASA在ImageNet-C基准测试中展现了在小批量、混合域及标签偏移场景下的鲁棒性，为在线模型持续学习提供了新思路。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究提出了一种利用多模态大模型辅助在线测试时适应的新方法，有效解决了模型自引用导致的错误累积问题。

glossary.explanationZh: 野外测试时适应，指模型在部署后面对动态变化的数据分布进行在线更新的过程。
自引用循环，指模型基于自身不准确的预测结果进行自我更新，导致错误被不断放大的现象。
多模态大模型锚定语义适应，一种利用MLLM提供外部语义参考来指导模型适应的方法。
归一化仿射参数，模型中常用于轻量级微调的参数层。
